name: @art-pollinator/discovery-lan
description: DiscoveryPort implementation for Wi-Fi/LAN (issue #44, pulled forward from Phase 2): on joining a network, probe known port(s) for the ArtPollinator service. Uses a plain HTTP probe-and-respond protocol (node:http server + fetch), not mDNS/UDP — see README.md for why, and specifically for how that keeps this working from the browser target with no BLE dependency.
